title: Manifesto | Hark
text:
Sign Up
At Hark, we are building the most advanced personal intelligence in the world.

We are witnessing a worldwide transformation. The dialogue between humans and machines is fundamentally shifting.

We now have intelligent systems that can use computers and are adept at reasoning. What becomes possible when computers start understanding and completing tasks on their own?

At Hark, we are building the most advanced personal intelligence in the world. Intelligence that begins to think like you and sometimes, ahead of you to offload your mental workload.

Imagine a system that interacts with the world exactly as you do: listening and speaking, seeing the world around it, building persistent memory, being proactive, and being able to touch and influence the world.

We are crafting a new interface to artificial intelligence. A series of bespoke native hardware devices and agentic computers partnered with end-to-end speech, text and vision models with highly personalised memory.

All our systems are multi-modal, built from scratch and capable of understanding and interacting in a natural way. Designed with detail and ultimate care.

Our ambitions are reflected in our incredible team. Our fingerprints already in everyone's hands, the services we use, and the interfaces we see, hear and touch.

We want to bring this advanced super intelligence to everyone in the world.

To develop this platform to make space for people to solve meaningful problems, create beautiful things, and spend time with those who matter most.
